description: The Porsche 911 GT3 Touring “Tree of Life” is a one-off Sonderwunsch creation celebrating 15 years of Porsche in Moldova. Its defining feature is a dramatic Viola purple metallic-to-Chromaflair Magic Magenta gradient, topped by a hand-painted Tree of Life graphic inspired by one of Moldova’s most important cultural symbols. Nearly 400 hours of craftsmanship went into the exterior alone, while bespoke Pasha fabric, Paldao wood and Moldovan-inspired details carry the theme into the cabin.
creator: kuroi
